name: Social Post Customizer for Jetpack
author: kusuworks

sections.description:
Social Post Customizer for Jetpack extends Jetpack Social by allowing you to customize selected parts of the Facebook message generated for a post. It provides settings for title length and shortening, URL display, excerpt display and length, fixed hashtags, and previewing the generated message.

Jetpack Social must be installed and configured. This plugin does not modify posts on other social networks.

Features

Post message settings

  • Configure the maximum title length and title shortening.
  • Choose whether to display the post URL.
  • Enable or disable the excerpt and configure its length.
  • Configure fixed hashtags.
  • Choose independently whether post categories and post tags are converted into hashtags.

Preview

Preview the generated post message before publishing.

Language Builder

Generate translation files from the Language Builder page.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Ensure Jetpack Social is installed, activated, and connected.
  4. Open Social Post Customizer for Jetpack from the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Configure the available post-message options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Jetpack Social?

Yes. Jetpack Social must be installed, activated, and connected.

Which social network is supported?

This plugin customizes Facebook post text generated by Jetpack Social. Other social networks are not modified by this plugin.

Can I customize hashtags?

You can configure fixed hashtags using the available settings.

Does the Free version include Premium features such as Smart Rules, templates, SNS analytics, or import/export settings?

No. Those features are not part of the current Free version. The admin screen includes a link to learn about the Premium edition.

What PHP version does the plugin require?

PHP 8.3 or later is required.
